propositions: Twelve grandfathered modules currently exceed the 800 LOC soft cap and persist via an allowlist escape hatch that must be eliminated by splitting each module along a logical call-graph seam and landing each split as a separate Gerrit change.

The allowlist/ceilings mechanism (.github/module-size-allowlist.txt, .github/module-size-ceilings.txt, and the sync contract test) must be completely removed so the 800 LOC limit becomes absolute and non-negotiable.
A hard gate must be added to prevent the 800 LOC limit itself from being changed through the normal contribution process, requiring manual admin override to modify the limit.
All child stories splitting grandfathered modules must land on main via Gerrit with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 votes.
After completion, no src/rebar/**/*.py file shall exceed 800 LOC and the allowlist/ceilings mechanism shall be entirely removed from the codebase.
